units.source_text: 他与暮光争抢，细数着他们的名字，但是书籍还是逐渐被沉郁的暮色所笼罩。

en.t: He raced against the twilight, counting their names one by one, but the books were still gradually enveloped in the somber dusk.

units.source_text: 最后他的耐心耗尽，想从西式梯子爬下来。

en.t: At last his patience ran out, and he tried to climb down from the Western-style ladder.

units.source_text: 突然，他头上挂着的一个秃灯泡亮了。

en.t: Suddenly, a bare light bulb hanging above his head came on.

units.source_text: 他站在梯子上，俯视在书架之间行走的店员和顾客。

en.t: He stood on the ladder, looking down at the clerks and customers walking between the bookshelves.

units.source_text: 他们显得那么矮小，甚是可怜寒碜。

en.t: They looked so small, utterly pitiable and shabby.
